subject: Thank you for being part of HYBRD
message:
Hey {name},

Quick note to say thank you. You're one of the first people training with HYBRD, and that means a lot. Every plan you build, every workout you sync and every bit of feedback helps shape what this becomes.

A few things to know:

We have a new name and new homes. The app is now at https://app.hybrdrunning.com and our website is https://hybrdrunning.com. If you added the app to your home screen, open the new address and add it again.

We're on Instagram: @hybrdrunning (https://www.instagram.com/hybrdrunning/). Follow along for training tips, new features and early looks at what's next.

Big things are coming soon. I can't share everything yet, but you'll be the first to see it.

If there's anything you'd add, change or fix, just reply to this email. I read every one.

Thanks for the support,
Matt
HYBRD Running
